historical_funding_coverage.cadence_methodology_note: Historical funding files contain both standard 8h settlements (00:00, 08:00, 16:00 UTC) and exchange-enacted 4h/2h/1h settlements (e.g., 1000BONKUSDT, ACEUSDT, AKTUSDT, SOLUSDT). All loaded settlement timestamps (both 8h and off-8h) are settled by the NAV engine whenever a position is open at that bar close hour. Because no external exchange schedule-change registry is bundled locally, missing-slot checks report both standard 8h grid slots and local-cadence inferred slots from adjacent settlement intervals.

output_semantics.root_nav_with_historical_funding_and_nav: Counterfactual replay holding ex-funding accepted IDs fixed when funding changes admission
output_semantics.report_source: Scenario-specific execution; root aliases used only when identical
